text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The promised day. I waited for Fuji Kiseki's mother
at the designated cafe.
choice_data_list: (I wonder what kind of Umamusume she is...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While I was zoning out—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is the waiter... singing...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And responding to that,
the people around stood up and began to sing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People holding brass instruments joined in,
dancers appeared, and then, at last—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"All the world's a stage,
And all the men and women merely players."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
My role is—your mother!
Hey there, long time no see, Fuji Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful Umamusume appeared,
looking like a more mature version of Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Long time no see, Mom! ...I forgot to mention it, but my mom's hobby is startling people."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to hear that from you. —Nice to meet you,
Trainer. Thank you for looking after my daughter."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meeting Fuji Kiseki's mother
was far more shocking than I had imagined...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“—I see? In other words, you want to know
how not to feel afraid during a show?”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Because I've never seen you look scared on stage. I want you to teach me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Well... that's—
Hehe!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! How could anyone
not be scared of that?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. Just a moment ago,
right before doing the flash mob,
even I was scared, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It was my first time meeting my daughter's Trainer.
I wanted to stage the best possible first impression.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Still, I was equally worried about what would happen if I failed.
It'd be awful if they ended up disillusioned, right?
choice_data_list: I had no idea at all...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, you two were spectators.
I couldn't go showing you a strained look on my face!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Were you always afraid too?
Just... like me...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
W-Was that really it?!
I had no idea at all, I totally thought...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At those words,
Fuji Kiseki's mother smiled faintly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"The stage is a living thing! Sometimes things go well,
other times they don't. Criticism and disappointment are part of the game."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You don't just give the audience positive feelings;
sometimes you impart negative ones as well.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, taking the stage as an entertainer
makes that sort of thing only natural.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...It was something I tried not to show in front of you, though.
Just a mother's little pride, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text: Now that I understand what's troubling you, there's a place I'd like to go. Come with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In front of the station. Amidst the bustling crowd stands a massive 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)' billboard featuring Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I know all about your situation.
About your current challenge,
and how highly the public regards it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Amidst all that, when you contacted me, it clicked.
—You're really struggling right now, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Wondering if you can meet those high expectations, if you're truly worthy of them.
I understand, you know. I've been there myself."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't beat you. I really should have
just asked straight out from the start."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She looked up at the billboard, gazing upon "Fuji Kiseki" and her fearless smile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mom.
What should I do if I fail?
How do I make it up to those I've disappointed—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text: There's no covering for that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
An entertainer can only perform on stage.
How the audience receives it is entirely up to them.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Once an actor steps off the stage,
they have no right to say anything to people like that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Even if I were to corner you and ask,
"Did you enjoy the show just now?"—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text: "There's no changing what's truly in your hearts, right? That's all there is to it!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...That might be true, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As Fuji Kiseki hesitated,
her mother smiled gently at her."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
All we can do,
whether we succeed or fail, is keep striving
forward toward the next goal.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text: That's the resolve needed to step onto the stage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The resolve... to step onto the stage...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I don't know all the details, but... basically,
the current Fuji just lacks resolve, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“‘What should I do about the people I disappointed?’
Such worry stems, in a sense, from a desire for self-preservation.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
The fear of losing my own worth
has become greater than creating satisfying entertainment.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
With that kind of resolve,
you can't create entertainment that satisfies the audience.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Look. So many people are taking photos
of the billboard featuring you. They're looking up and talking with smiles on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text: What is the most important thing you should be doing right now, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with her mother,
Fuji Kiseki seemed unusually downcast.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I'm glad I had you by my side.
Good medicine tastes bitter, as they say.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still,
thanks to that, there's something I came to realize!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I was acting on stage,
all I ever cared about was my mother's evaluation
and how I was being judged in comparison to her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There was no way I could compete with her,
focused purely on self-expression as an entertainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And Fuji Kiseki let out a soft sigh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since entering the Senior Year,
I haven't been able to focus purely on the competition like I did back then.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I got so caught up in trying to figure out how to cover it up..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's why my anxiety grew even worse. If I had
just stayed focused, I wouldn't have slipped so far.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—The way I am now,
I can never become the ultimate entertainer."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you want to captivate everyone watching,
you can't be afraid of getting hurt.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You can't create the greatest entertainment
without life-or-death determination...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Fuji Kiseki, who had surely been subjected to harsh words,
looked surprisingly refreshed."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I've finally gotten the hang of it!
Though facing the remaining Senior-class grand stages is terrifying—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I feel like if I can overcome this,
I'll be able to take that next step forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki smiled with utter confidence, though her cheek twitched just a tiny bit—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wonder. Can I overcome this?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I've known it for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That Étoile is truly befitting of you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That Étoile is truly befitting of you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She captivates everyone and captures their hearts directly,
shining like the brightest star in the night sky—
choice_data_list: After all, I'm the most dazzling étoile!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I see, Étoile, huh... That's right, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. As expected,
you know me very well, don't you!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Her blue eyes began to glint with a mischievous spark, just like back then."
